summary: Lists sanity tests available via ansible-test sanity --test for collections, also shown by --list-tests --allow-disabled, with extra tests for ansible-core.
questions: How do I list all available sanity tests?

answer_card.title: List sanity tests
answer_card.answer_md:
```shell
ansible-test sanity --list-tests --allow-disabled
```
Use a name with `ansible-test sanity --test <name>`. ansible-core has some extra tests.
